description.en: UniteMind AI builds scheduling agents for fleets, crews, machines and computing jobs.
description.zh: UniteMind AI 为车队、班组、设备和算力任务打造智能调度系统。

heading.en: Plans change. Your schedule keeps up.

text.en: UniteMind AI builds scheduling agents for fleets, crews and machines. When a road closes or a vehicle drops out, they find a new plan and show your dispatcher why.
text.zh: UniteMind AI 为车队、班组和设备打造智能调度系统。道路封闭或车辆停运时，它会找出新的计划，并告诉调度员为什么这样安排。

note.en: Made-up map and orders. The planning is real and runs in your browser.
note.zh: 地图和订单是虚构的，规划过程是真实的，就在你的浏览器里运行。

mapAlt.en: Road map with four vehicles driving to their assigned jobs
mapAlt.zh: 道路图：四辆车正驶向各自的任务

timelineAlt.en: Timeline of each vehicle's planned jobs

logStart.en: Plan ready. Four vehicles on the road.
logStart.zh: 计划已生成，四辆车已出发。

logResult.en: Old plan: {a} late. New plan: {b} late. Jobs reassigned: {m}.
logResult.zh: 原计划迟到 {a} 单，新计划迟到 {b} 单，改派 {m} 单。

logTime.zh: 重新规划用时 {ms} 毫秒

heading.en: From a messy day to a plan you can send.
heading.zh: 把混乱的一天，变成可以下发的计划。

text.en: Orders, positions, shifts and road status come together in one live picture, so every decision starts from the same facts.
text.zh: 订单、位置、班次和路况汇成一张实时全景图，每个决定都基于同样的事实。

text.en: The solver compares ways to assign the work, drops the ones that break your rules, and keeps the plan with the least delay.
text.zh: 求解器比较各种派工方式，排除违反规则的方案，保留延误最少的计划。

title.en: Change only what has to change

text.en: When a road closes, the affected jobs move and the rest of the day stays put. A person approves the change before it goes out.
text.zh: 道路封闭时，只调整受影响的任务，其余安排不变。改动下发之前，由人确认。

alt.en: Diagram: vehicles and jobs, then routes, then a changed route around a closed road
alt.zh: 示意图：先是车辆和任务，然后是路线，最后绕开封闭道路的新路线

heading.en: One planner, four kinds of work.

text.en: Match loads to vehicles and keep routes on time.
text.zh: 把货物匹配给车辆，让路线保持准时。

text.en: Send the right skills to the right site.
text.zh: 把合适的人派到合适的现场。

text.en: Order the work to cut changeovers and waiting.
text.zh: 合理排产，减少换线和等待。

text.en: Place jobs on GPUs by deadline and priority.
text.zh: 按截止时间和优先级把任务分配到 GPU。

heading.en: Built for the people who run the day.

text.en: Say the rule the way you would say it to a colleague. It becomes a limit the solver must respect.
text.zh: 像跟同事说话一样说出规则，它就会变成求解器必须遵守的限制。

said.en: “Crew B can't start before 9 on Mondays.”
said.zh: “周一 9 点前，B 组不能开工。”

text.en: Each change says what moved, what it saves and which rule it keeps.
text.zh: 每次改动都会写明改了什么、省了多少、遵守了哪条规则。

text.en: Approve, edit or reject any change. You choose which ones may go out on their own.
text.zh: 任何改动都可以批准、修改或拒绝，哪些可以自动下发由你决定。

text.en: Start from a spreadsheet, then connect the systems you already use.
text.zh: 先从一张表格开始，再接入你正在用的系统。

text.en: We run your past schedules through the planner and compare the results with what happened.
text.zh: 用你过去的排班数据跑一遍，和实际情况对比。

text.en: The planner runs beside your dispatchers. It suggests and nothing is sent.
text.zh: 系统和调度员同时运行，只给建议，不下发任何指令。

text.en: Dispatchers approve changes from one screen, and you decide how far to go.
text.zh: 调度员在一个界面里确认改动，用到什么程度由你决定。

q.zh: 它会取代我们的调度员吗？

a.en: No. It proposes plans and explains them. Your dispatchers approve, edit or reject.
a.zh: 不会。它提出计划并说明理由，由调度员批准、修改或拒绝。

q.en: What data do we need to begin?

a.en: A list of jobs, a list of vehicles, crews or machines, and your time rules. A spreadsheet is enough for the first replay.
a.zh: 任务清单，车辆、班组或设备的清单，以及时间规则。第一次回放用一张表格就够。

q.en: Where does the AI come in?

a.en: Language models read requests and rules. A solver builds the schedule, and code checks every hard limit before a plan is shown.
a.zh: 语言模型负责理解需求和规则，求解器负责排计划，展示之前由程序检查每一条硬性限制。

q.en: Is the demo on this page real?
q.zh: 这个页面上的演示是真的吗？

a.en: The map and orders are made up. The planning is real: every time you break the plan, your browser computes a new one.
a.zh: 地图和订单是虚构的，但规划是真的：你每打乱一次计划，浏览器就会重新计算一次。

heading.en: Bring us the schedule that keeps breaking.
heading.zh: 把那份总被打乱的排班给我们看看。

text.en: Tell us what you schedule, how many vehicles, crews or machines you have, and what goes wrong most often.
text.zh: 告诉我们你在调度什么、有多少车辆、班组或设备，以及最常出什么问题。

note.en: Intelligent scheduling for fleets, crews, machines and computing.
note.zh: 面向车队、班组、设备和算力的智能调度。
